messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the skirt, and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the skirt, and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands in the middle of the road, then turns her body and raises her arms to adjust her hair before settling into a standing pose with hands on her hips.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot from across the road.","clothing":"A bright pink long-sleeved zip-up top with white stripes on the sleeves, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and black ankle boots.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled in two high buns on top of her head.","identity":"A slender young woman with a slim build and fair skin.","scene":"An outdoor paved road under a concrete overpass, with orange-and-white construction barriers, traffic signs, a metal guardrail, and trees in the background under bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's black dress and white sneakers were replaced by a bright pink long-sleeved top, a light pink pleated mini skirt, and black ankle boots. Her pose, hair, body, and the road/overpass scene remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: pink long-sleeved top, pink pleated mini skirt, and black ankle boots, while preserving everything else.
uncertain: Whether the top's exact color and sleeve details fully match the reference images.
unexpected_changes: The applied top has visible white stripes on the sleeves, which are not clearly present in the reference outfit.
